adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the new code always paginates for every group: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i`, then `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)`. There is no lower-bound check, so a request like `?offset=-1` (or `limit=-1`) can pass a negative value into ActiveRecord, which will generate SQL with a negative OFFSET/LIMIT. This can cause a DB error/500 on the public members endpoint. Previously, limit/offset were only applied for `group.automatic?`, so the change broadens the exposure to all groups.
